title: Japan Romance Trail with Hokkaido
alt: Lavender rows at Tomita Farm in Furano, Hokkaido
transport: Flights, bullet trains and guided day tours

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Mount Fuji
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Super deluxe room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Shinjuku, a short walk from the station

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day from the LOVE statue in Shinjuku through Meiji shrine, the Imperial Palace gardens and the temple lanes of Asakusa.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Three nights in Shinjuku with a guided city day and the Mount Fuji fifth station with the Gotemba outlets.

stops.name: Sapporo
stops.subtitle: Sapporo to Furano and Lake Toya
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Deluxe room · 3★ · Central Sapporo hotel with its own hot spring bath on the top floor

activities.match: Day Tour to Lake Toya, Showa-shinzan & Jigokudani Volcano Valley

program.name: Sapporo
program.description: Two nights in Sapporo with the flower fields of Furano and Biei, and a volcano day around Lake Toya.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel opposite Shin-Osaka station, handy for the trains

activities.name: Sumo show experience
activities.description: A demonstration bout with retired wrestlers who explain the rituals, let you into the ring and serve the stew they live on.

activities.name: Universal Studios Japan

program.name: Osaka

day_titles.6: Lake Toya and the hell valley

1: Arrival at Narita or Haneda and transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Shinjuku hotel
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: the Tokyo Metropolitan Building viewing decks, free of charge
2: Breakfast, then a guided day through the city
Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens
Asakusa and the Senso-ji temple lanes
3: Breakfast, then out of the city towards Mount Fuji
The fifth station on the mountain, weather permitting
Lake Ashi and the Hakone viewpoints
A shopping stop at the Gotemba outlets
4: Breakfast and check out, then on to Hokkaido
Transfer into central Sapporo and check in
Rest of the day free in the city
Optional: the hot spring bath on the top floor
5: Breakfast, then a full day out to Furano
The lavender rows of Tomita Farm
Shikisai Hill and the Blue Pond at Shirogane
A stop at Campana Rokkatei on the way back
6: Breakfast, then south to Lake Toya
The caldera lake and Showa-shinzan volcano
The steaming Jigokudani valley at Noboribetsu
Back in Sapporo in the evening

A sumo show with retired wrestlers
The stew the wrestlers live on, served afterwards

Tickets included for the full day
Super Nintendo World and the Harry Potter area
9: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Kansai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Tokyo, the Hokkaido flower fields and then Osaka. Three very different weeks of Japan squeezed into nine days.
expert.tip: Go in July for the lavender at Tomita Farm. The Dormy Inn has a rooftop hot spring, which is the right way to end a long touring day.

summary: Nine days for two: three nights in Shinjuku with a city day and Mount Fuji, two in Sapporo for the Furano flower fields and a volcano day at Lake Toya, then two in Osaka with a sumo show and Universal Studios Japan.
included: Included: 8 nights with breakfast on most mornings; flights and trains within Japan; private airport transfers; Tokyo sightseeing tour; Mount Fuji fifth station with Hakone and the Gotemba outlets; Furano Tomita Farm, Shikisai Hill and the Blue Pond; Lake Toya, Showa-shinzan and the Jigokudani valley; Osaka sumo show; Universal Studios Japan tickets.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
